verdict.rationale: The axis applies: AnythingLLM is an AI assistant with an in-product @agent, so supervising or embedding coding agents is a fair question. However, nothing in the pack shows it cloning repos, editing code, running tests, or orchestrating an external coding agent. Custom Agent Skills, Agent Flows and MCP compatibility are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, the assistant can supervise or embed real coding agents so it does repo work — cloning, editing, testing — not just snippets in chat
